description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class EmployeeDirectoryDaoTest for testing the EmployeeDirectoryDao component of the OrangeHRM Corporate Directory plugin. It sets up test cases to verify the retrieval and filtering of employee data within the directory, utilizing mock data and assertion checks.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeDirectoryDao, which includes methods to validate fetching employee lists and counts based on various filters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of employee lists with different search filters and assertions to verify correctness.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Tests the employee count retrieval with various filter configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an EmployeeDirectoryDao instance and populating test data from a fixture file.
